title: Single-open unit compatibility of canonical direct-image comparison
statement: Let $h:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Assume the derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category] on $X,Y$ and all their opens exist. For an arbitrary open $U\subseteq Y$ and $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ let $c_U$ and $a_{X,h^{-1}U},a_{Y,U}$ be the fixed comparison and derived restriction adjunctions of [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data]. With direct image as in [def-pc-derived-direct-image] and restriction as in [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], $Rh_*(\eta_{X,h^{-1}U}(E))\,c_U(E)=\eta_{Y,U}(Rh_*E)$, in Lean composition order. No covering hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 08BV (lemma-exact-sequence-j-star), 08FE (lemma-restrict-direct-image-open) and 0D5T (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition); official Stacks pages read online

proof.text: Define the two counit composites as natural transformations from RjX_* followed by Rh_* and then restriction to U, to Rg_*. On a K-injective representative of an arbitrary object A on h inverse image U, apply the normalized-comparison counit computation [lem-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-open-composition-counit]. Naturality of both composites along the fixed resolution isomorphism schemeMVResolutionIso and cancellation of its image extend the counit equality to every A. This extension is the proved private counit_transport and composition_counit calculation.

Transpose the required unit equality under the Y-open adjunction Hom equivalence. Expand the open comparison as the composition comparison beta followed by RjY_* of the inverse restriction comparison alpha. Counit naturality moves this inverse alpha past the Y counit. Apply the extended counit equality at A=LX(E). Naturality of alpha for the X-open unit then reduces the composite to alpha at E followed by Rg_* of LX(unit_X(E)) composed with counit_X(LX(E)), followed by alpha inverse at E. The X-adjunction left triangle identity makes the middle factor the identity; alpha followed by alpha inverse is the identity. The Y Hom equivalence is injective, so its transpose equality proves the original unit equation. This is the proved private unit_of_counit calculation. The statement, all universes and all hypotheses remain unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08FE (lemma-restrict-direct-image-open), 0D5T (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition) and 08BV (lemma-exact-sequence-j-star); official Stacks pages read online
proof_origin.note: Decomposition: one K-injective counit-computation hole remains; naturality transport and the unit/counit triangle calculation are proved in Lean. The unit route is unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem schemeMVOpenComparison_unit
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (U : Y.Opens) (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    (schemeDerivedDirectImage h).map ((schemeMVAdjunction X (h ⁻¹ᵁ U)).unit.app E) ≫
        (schemeMVOpenComparison h U E).hom =
      (schemeMVAdjunction Y U).unit.app ((schemeDerivedDirectImage h).obj E)
